name: media-switcher
title: Media Switcher
description: Quickly switch between media sessions, control playback and adjust volume — all from the keyboard
author: muhammadrizo

preferences.name: prevNextTrackShortcuts
preferences.title: Previous / Next Track Shortcuts
preferences.description: Choose shortcuts for the "Previous Track" and "Next Track" actions

preferences.name: refreshInterval
preferences.title: Refresh Interval (seconds)
preferences.description: How often to auto-refresh the media session list. Set to 0 to disable

preferences.name: volumeStep
preferences.title: Volume Step
preferences.description: How much to increase or decrease the volume by

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
